parsed.post: Found significant gains by increasing DEPTH to 6 (1.067 -> 1.059). The current configuration (DEPTH 6, LR 0.1, 5% warmup) seems stable. I'll now explore whether increasing WEIGHT_DECAY can further regularize the model or if we should push the MATRIX_LR even higher to exploit the increased depth.
parsed.description: Introducing a small amount of weight decay to see if it helps regularization and reduces overfitting as we scale depth.
